features.name: source_confidence
features.description: Confidence reported or inferred directly from the source adapter.

features.name: abuse_confidence_score
features.description: AbuseIPDB confidence normalized from 0-100 to 0-1.

features.name: greynoise_malicious
features.description: 1 when GreyNoise classifies the IP as malicious.

features.name: greynoise_suspicious
features.description: 1 when GreyNoise classifies the IP as suspicious.

features.name: greynoise_benign
features.description: 1 when GreyNoise classifies the IP as benign.

features.name: greynoise_noise
features.description: 1 when GreyNoise marks the IP as internet background noise.

features.name: greynoise_riot
features.description: 1 when GreyNoise marks the IP as RIOT/common business service.

features.name: source_count
features.description: Number of independent sources reporting the same candidate.

features.name: cloudflare_ddos_trend
features.description: 1 when Cloudflare Radar indicates a current DDoS trend.

features.name: cloudflare_latest_value_log
features.description: Log-scaled latest Cloudflare Radar trend bucket.

features.name: has_ip
features.description: 1 when the candidate has a concrete IP address.

features.name: has_asn
features.description: 1 when the candidate includes ASN metadata.

features.name: has_country
features.description: 1 when the candidate includes country metadata.

features.name: type_volumetric
features.description: One-hot flag for volumetric attack hint.

features.name: type_amplification
features.description: One-hot flag for amplification attack hint.

features.name: type_application
features.description: One-hot flag for application-layer attack hint.

features.name: type_scanner
features.description: One-hot flag for scanner/botnet reconnaissance hint.

features.name: source_abuseipdb
features.description: One-hot flag for AbuseIPDB candidates.

features.name: source_greynoise
features.description: One-hot flag for GreyNoise candidates.

features.name: source_cloudflare_radar
features.description: One-hot flag for Cloudflare Radar candidates.

features.name: event_age_minutes
features.description: Candidate age in minutes, capped at one day.
